bug_semantics: CWE-78 OS command injection in the file-system MCP server. checkSyntax() and runPlaywrightTest() in ai/mcp/server/file-system/services/FileSystemService.mjs pass ensureSandboxed(absolutePath) and then interpolate that string into child_process.exec via `node --check ${safePath}` and `npx playwright test ${safePath}`. ensureSandboxed only checks path.resolve prefix containment against process.cwd(); it does not treat the value as a shell token. An MCP tool argument such as <root>/README.md; id is admitted by the jail and executed as two shell commands under the developer-local stdio server process.
flaw_origin: The interpolation was born with the file-system MCP server, not added later. fae8a8755faf10cb302f3ce72face7efb7d30a2d (2026-04-07, issue #9750) first created FileSystemService.mjs with promisify(exec) and the two unquoted template strings. Subsequent touches (healthcheck status, a later AI refactor) left those sinks unchanged until the argv/execFile landing.
